verdict.rationale: Luma is a generative video/image SaaS and API platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents one: the docs cover REST endpoints, SDKs, llms.txt, markdown mirrors and assistant-open links, none of which is an MCP server. Its 'Luma Agents' are its own agent product, not an MCP endpoint that external agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
